name: MoxieMag Teen Interns (MCA Denver)
what_you_do: High school interns make a printed and online teen magazine. They take field trips, hear guest speakers and work with museum staff.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page does not list exact ages or a city rule.
duration: Meets Tuesdays 4:30 to 6:30 PM, one semester
deadline_text: Applications open mid-November to mid-December for spring, and May to June for fall.
how_to_apply: Apply through the MCA Denver teens page when the window opens. Email teens@mcadenver.org with questions.
notes: Meets Tuesdays 4:30 to 6:30 PM, one semester. Admission to MCA Denver is free for teens. Exact 2026 to 2027 dates are not posted, so this uses the usual pattern.
